Class ClassCardController

java.lang.Object
controller.components.ClassCardController
public class ClassCardController extends Object
Controller for a class card component. Displays class information differently based on user role (teacher or student). Includes progress tracking and handles card interactions.

  • Method Details

    • applyRoleVariant

      public void applyRoleVariant()
      Applies the appropriate UI variant based on the current user's role. Shows teacher-specific information for teachers, student-specific information for students.

    • setStudentCard

      public void setStudentCard(String classCode, String teacherName, double progress)
      Configures the card to display student view information. Shows the class name, teacher name, and progress.
      Parameters:
      classCode - The name/code of the class
      teacherName - The full name of the teacher
      progress - The progress value (0.0 to 1.0)

    • setTeacherCard

      public void setTeacherCard(String classCode, int students, int sets, double progress)
      Configures the card to display teacher view information. Shows the class name, number of students, number of flashcard sets, and progress.
      Parameters:
      classCode - The name/code of the class
      students - The number of students in the class
      sets - The number of flashcard sets in the class
      progress - The progress value (0.0 to 1.0)

    • setProgress

      public void setProgress(double value)
      Updates the progress bar and progress text label. Displays the progress as a percentage value.
      Parameters:
      value - The progress value as a decimal (0.0 to 1.0)

    • setOnClick

      public void setOnClick(Runnable r)
      Sets the callback to be invoked when the card is clicked/fired.
      Parameters:
      r - The Runnable to execute on card click

    • fire

      public void fire()
      Invokes the onClick callback if one has been set. Used to trigger the card's associated action when clicked.
